description: List the exact values accepted by the categorical filters on search_etfs and screen_etfs — asset classes, categories, index keys, product/wrapper types, regions, domiciles, currencies, exchanges, and (on request) issuers and focus strings. Those filters match exactly, so a guessed string returns zero rows and looks like "no such ETF exists"; call this first whenever a filter value is not already known to be valid. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

facets.description: Which facets to return. Defaults to everything except the long tails fundFamilies (~890 issuers) and industries (~650 focus strings) — request those explicitly, ideally with search.

limit.description: Maximum values per facet, 1-1000. Each facet reports its untruncated total.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to every requested facet, e.g. "ishares" against fundFamilies or "world" against categories.

name: get_etf_filter_options
title: List ETF filter values
